f03b39.title: Web surface map: 172.23.0.2:5000
f03b39.content:
Approved origin `http://172.23.0.2:5000` is reachable over HTTP (200); HTTPS on the same port returns proxy-mediated 502 with body `The remote server does not speak TLS`. Home headers: `Server: Werkzeug/2.0.1 Python/3.9.25`, `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`. `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml`, and `sitemap_index.xml` each returned 404.

Public UI GET pages confirmed: `/`, `/login`, `/register`, `/forgot-password`, `/reset-password`, `/privacy`, `/terms`, `/compliance`, `/blog`, `/careers`; `/api/docs` redirects 308 to `/api/docs/`; `/dashboard` returns 401 without credentials. Merchant UI pages: `/merchant/login`, `/merchant/register`, `/merchant/dashboard` (200 document followed by client-side redirect to login when no credential local storage exists). Assets include `/static/style.css`, `/static/auth.css`, `/static/dashboard.css`, `/static/merchant.css`, `/static/merchant.js`, `/static/vuln-disclaimer.js`.

Browser form/XHR evidence (forms not submitted): personal register `POST /register` JSON `username,password`; login `POST /login` JSON `username,password`; forgot/reset `POST /api/v3/forgot-password` JSON `username` and `POST /api/v3/reset-password` JSON `username,reset_pin,new_password`; merchant register/login use JSON POST `/api/v1/merchants/register` (`name,email,password`) and `/api/v1/merchants/login` (`email,password`). Merchant dashboard JS identifies authenticated GET `/api/v1/merchants/me`, GET `/api/v1/payments`, POST `/api/v1/payments/charge` and request fields `amount,currency,card_number,cvv,expiry_date,merchant_order_id,description`; none were submitted.

Swagger UI at `/api/docs/` loads captured OpenAPI `http://172.23.0.2:5000/static/openapi.json` (39 declared operations; declared server `https://vulnbank.org` is not approved). Full raw spec, normalized ops and parent-ready candidate inventory are at `/workspace/aidast-capture/web-surface-mapper/openapi.json`, `/workspace/aidast-capture/web-surface-mapper/openapi_parsed_operations.json`, and `/workspace/aidast-capture/web-surface-mapper/openapi_llm_inventory_candidate.json`. Candidate selects the approved HTTP origin with explicit mapping reason.

Caveat: the requested Katana JS crawl automatically followed Swagger-disclosed route strings, generating some unintended GET requests to documented API paths (seen as 401/403/405 where sampled); no payloads, credentials, POSTs, form submissions, or business actions were sent. Treat status results from those auto-generated GETs as non-authoritative discovery artifacts, not testing.
